rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for movable goods offered for sale.

example.english: The commodity sold at this shop is pretty cheap.
example.traditional: 呢間舖賣嘅貨品幾平喎。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 maai6 ge3 fo3 ban2 gei2 peng4 wo3

rows.note: Use this for an ordinary mass-market product contrasted with a branded or distinctive one.

example.english: This commodity has little profit margin and cannot compete with branded goods.
example.traditional: 呢件大路貨冇乜利潤，同名牌貨冇得比。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 daai6 lou6 fo3 mou5 mat1 lei6 jeon6 tung4 ming4 paai4 fo3 mou5 dak1 bei2

rows.note: Use this specifically for raw materials and other primary products traded in bulk on organized markets.

example.english: Oil is an important commodity in global markets.
example.traditional: 石油係全球市場上重要嘅大宗商品。
example.jyutping: sek6 jau4 hai6 cyun4 kau4 si5 coeng4 soeng6 zung6 jiu3 ge3 daai6 zung1 soeng1 ban2
